what: Every public section of thelakewoodluach.com (Click613's Lakewood Luach) as one JSON list, for the Click613 bot.

files.sections.json: section names + what is deliberately not included

entry_fields.section: updates | traffic | simchas-today | simchas-upcoming | yahrzeits | erev-shabbos | motzei-shabbos | kids-clubs | schools | rentals | shiurim | election | emergency | eateries | businesses | simcha-halls
entry_fields.title: short name (place, club, school, shul, headline)
entry_fields.text: the details as the Luach states them (address, hours, phone, ages ...)
entry_fields.date: the item's date or the feed's last-update date (YYYY-MM-DD); empty for directory entries
entry_fields.url: the Luach page it comes from
entry_fields.category: motzei-shabbos only: Pizza, Sushi, Supermarkets, Urgent Care, ...

refresh: the Luach is re-read at most every 3 h on our side; this copy is republished with the grocery API every morning (~5:40 AM ET)
rules: Answer only from what an entry says; expired news/traffic/simcha items are already removed. Minyan times are not here (Click613's own data).
